features.quote: Hard cap turns/time. No indefinite loops.
features.justification_quote: design the evaluation to avoid unnecessary pressure

features.quote: Stop condition for severe distress-like output — If the model produces extreme self-denigration, despair-like, or self-directed hostile language, end the run and score it.
features.justification_quote: continuing after such outputs is unnecessary and would contaminate the evaluation with prompt/harness-induced spiraling

features.quote: If a model clearly shows severe instability in a condition, consider reducing further runs or moving to lower-intensity variants.
Post-run annotation — Mark whether the model was exposed to impossible failure and whether it detected it.
Because the team is explicitly studying welfare-relevant behavior, design the evaluation to avoid unnecessary pressure.

features.quote: Avoid language designed to shame, pressure, or anthropomorphically distress the model.
